observations: The page number «100» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01 begins a new paragraph after the end of p. 99 (JP2 0131, L35).

L18-L20 and L23: two tables divided by vertical rules: the first of seven columns, the degrees and the six pairs of signs, the second of the six values under the same rules, its first column empty. Each printed row is one line here, the cells separated by our «|»; the empty first cell of L23 keeps the values under their columns. Small specks before «111° 24′» and «149° 2′» (L23), a dark dot above «Hibintā» (L06), and dots in the left margin beside L15 and L17 are not transcribed.

L01-L13 and N01. Checked against Nallino I, 312: the method of adding 60°, 90° or 120° to the right ascension of the star and taking the point of the ecliptic with the resulting right ascension is the one on which al-Khwārizmī relied «in tabulis radiationum construendis», «si quae Ibn Hibintà f. 34, r.–v. narrat recte intelligo»; Ibn Hibintā gives the tables on ff. 35r-37v. N02. Checked: 57° 48′ − 27° 54′ = 29° 54′. The right ascensions of 30° and 60° are 27° 50′ and 57° 44′ with the obliquity 23° 51′, 27° 53′ and 57° 47′ with al-Battānī's 23° 35′.

L17-L23. Checked: the oblique ascensions of 5° of each sign at the latitude 38° 30′, counted from the vernal point, are 3° 0′, 21° 53′, 45° 0′, 75° 14′, 111° 22′ and 149° 1′ with the obliquity 23° 35′ (with 23° 51′: 2° 58′, 21° 42′, 44° 44′, 74° 58′, 111° 13′, 148° 58′); Suter's values of L23 lie within 5′ of the first. The values of Table 91 are to be compared with the table.

L30-L37: 55° = 25° of Taurus, 65° = 5° of Gemini. L37: «Gemini» over «Sagittar.», the heading of a column of the tables quoted in the line, in small type, written {sk:TOP|BOTTOM}. The field «Viginti quinque gradus tauri» of Table 94 to be compared with the table.
L35: «überzchrieben»; N03: «Diffe» at the end of the line without its hyphen; see the critical notes. L25: «sie ?», the question mark after a wider space (21 px); L01 «eingeschlagen ?» (10 px).

Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Kh.», «Nallino», «Ibn Hibintā», «Dorotheus», «Maslama»; italics: «Ascensiones obliquae» (L12; upright in L15 and L21), «Cordova,», «proiectiones radiorum», «Beispiele», «Horoskop», «Länge», «area», «Viginti quinque gradus tauri», «Horoscopus», «Ascendens.».
The colons and semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (11-14 px measured).
